body:
Colleagues, could you please check wordings in [10.4.16](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x19-V10-OAuth2-and-OIDC.md#v104-oauth-authorization-server):

> such mutual TLS ('tls_client_auth', 'self_signed_tls_client_auth') or private key JWT ('private_key_jwt').

it seems "as" missed here and should be 

> such **as** mutual TLS ('tls_client_auth', 'self_signed_tls_client_auth') or private key JWT ('private_key_jwt').
title: 10.4.16 Check wordings
